newsitem.title: DENMARK: Analysts see lower growth in Danish June reserves.
newsitem.headline: Analysts see lower growth in Danish June reserves.

text.p: Four analysts polled by Reuters in a forecast published on Wednesday foresaw Denmark's foreign reserves rising to an average 109.2 billion crowns at end-June from end-May's 108.8 billion crowns.
The forecast, which excluded net foreign loan transactions, swung from a low of 108.8 billion crowns to a high of 110.3 billion crowns.
If the estimates hold it would mean lower growth in Denmark's foreign reserves than in April or May 1997, when 7.4 and 7.0 billion crown monthly rises were reported respectively.
The Danish central bank issues its end-June foreign reserves data on Wednesday July 2 at 1400 GMT.
